name: ROYBI Robot
description: A stationary, screenless educational companion for ages 3–7, built around a pre-authored lesson library (500+ lessons) for language learning (English plus Spanish, French, and Mandarin) and basic STEM — a scripted, curriculum-driven design rather than open-ended AI conversation. Current company activity and stock availability are uncertain as of this research.

specs.note: $149 base price includes all 500+ lessons; app has historically offered optional $2.99 per-lesson-pack IAPs, not a required recurring fee

sourcing: Verified against ROYBI's own store and product materials, The Robot Report, EdSurge, CES.tech, a January 2021 company press release, a 2024 Talk Business & Politics piece on the company's Arkansas expansion, independent reviews (New Literacies, rachelbustin.com, Best Buy Canada), and retailer listings (Walmart, a liquidation retailer). Founding year, HQ city, and seed-round investor identities are inconsistent or undisclosed across sources. No Toyota/Toyota AI Ventures investment was corroborated anywhere and should be treated as unconfirmed. Whether a subscription is currently required for any content tier is not fully settled. Most significantly: no confirmed company or product news from 2025–2026 was found, and the product is currently out of stock across every retail channel checked — this is flagged directly rather than presented as an actively thriving product.

pricing.summary: Officially listed at $149 on ROYBI's own store (roybi.world), though that listing currently shows sold out, and Walmart's listing is also out of stock. A liquidation retailer has been clearing remaining units at a steep discount against a cited $207 retail reference price.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware — Company Status Worth Flagging
editorial.body: ROYBI runs on a pre-authored curriculum (500+ lessons, ~70 categories) with machine-learning personalization for pacing, not open-ended AI chat. Language claims have expanded from "first bilingual" (English/Chinese) to four languages. Worth flagging: no confirmed news since August 2024, and it's sold out at ROYBI's store and Walmart, with a liquidator discounting inventory — no confirmed shutdown, but unclear if shipping.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Despite a plausible-sounding association, no source confirms any Toyota or Toyota AI Ventures investment in ROYBI — this should be treated as unconfirmed rather than fact.

firmwareCommunity.note: ROYBI Robot has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
